title: frameledger budget --json
description: The result of `frameledger budget FILE BUDGETS --json`: whether one run meets its pass budgets. A later release may add keys, and values to the open sets; a script ignores what it does not know. Print this file from the same frameledger that printed the result.

frameledger.description: The version of the frameledger that printed this.

summary.description: The opening sentences of the text output, in order. Wording may change in any release.

overrides.description: The --override flags given; empty for a command that takes none.

warnings.description: The warnings, each also a sentence in summary.

line.description: The line of the budget file, from 1.

segment_kind.description: The segment kind judged; null for frames with no segment. A budget for any kind has an entry for each kind it matched.

category.description: The row's category: frame, cpu or gpu.

depth.description: The depth judged at; null for a frame row.

over_ms.description: The value less the limit, in ms; negative when the value is under the limit.

over.description: Whether the value is over the limit.

frames.description: The frames the value is taken over.

budgets.description: Each budget that matched the run, in the file's order.

line.description: The line of the budget file, from 1.

segment_kind.description: The segment kind the budget names; * for any, null for frames with no segment.

category.description: The row's category: frame, cpu or gpu.

depth.description: The depth the budget names, or null when it names none.

unmatched.description: Each budget that matched nothing in the run.

warmup_s.description: --warmup-s: the seconds left out at the start.

rows_dropped.description: The close line's count of rows the writer dropped; null when the run has no close line.

finished.description: Whether the run has a close line.

generated_frames.description: How many of the run's frames a frame generator made.

result.description: Each budget against the run. With the verdict error, a file could not be read or breaks its format, and result holds no key.

budget_verdict.description: The verdict of budget: pass, fail, inconclusive when the run cannot settle it, or error when a file could not be read or breaks its format. A closed set.

budget_exit_code.description: The exit codes the result of budget can carry. A closed set.

code.description: What kind of warning it is. An open set: a later release may add a code, and a script ignores one it does not know. file_error says a file could not be read.

warning.description: One warning. Its sentence is also in summary.

field.description: The header field that may differ.

override.description: One blocking field a --override flag let differ.

statistic.description: How a run's frames become one value: the median or the 99th percentile, nearest-rank. A closed set.
